steps.en: Pull the agent (static binary and Docker image both exist)
steps.zh: 拉取 agent（静态二进制或镜像）

steps.en: Write one TOML declaring a few inputs and one output
steps.zh: 写一份 TOML，声明输入和输出

steps.en: Launch the agent with that config mounted in
steps.zh: 挂上这份配置启动 agent

steps.en: Collects data from each input at its own interval
steps.zh: 按各自的 interval 从每个输入采集数据

steps.en: Processes, aggregates, and writes points to your outputs at each flush interval
steps.zh: 按 flush 间隔处理、聚合并写到输出

value.en: Heterogeneous hosts, databases, queues and PLCs streaming into whichever backend you query, with no glue code
value.zh: 主机、数据库、消息队列乃至 PLC 的数据都流进你查询的那个后端，不用写胶水代码
